notes: A new Home with posters, overviews and episode names for films and shows, and TMPlayer rows on the Android TV home screen. A setup and a quick tour after sign in, in every language, with Performance and Mobile data steps; existing users are offered the tour once. Low storage mode streams videos larger than the free space, and Save mobile data fetches only a few minutes ahead on mobile data. Skip intro, recap and credits, speed remembered per series, preferred audio and subtitle language, watch later, season downloads, bookmarks, A-B repeat and skip silence. Backups of settings and lists, an app PIN and a kids lock with allowed chats. After a crash, TMPlayer asks before sending a report, once or always. A macOS preview for Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 26 or newer. New icons, the desktop's own window buttons, and many fixes for right-to-left languages, TV focus and long translations.
